description:
Hushfeed v0.71.1 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

47.1.4 is still the only supported version, so patch that APK with your usual signing key.

Two small fixes on top of 0.71.0. With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption stays where TikTok showed it instead of dropping to the bottom edge. With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, the strip under the clock is shaded like the rest of the room's top. The release notes list every report 0.71.0 and 0.71.1 changed something for.

Validation: 3874 runtime tests passed and 765 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 132 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. Patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 on a Galaxy S22, the caption kept in Clear display sat at the same height TikTok showed it.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
